proofs.text: Run with `--gate recorded` and verify the approver question is absent; run with `--gate approved` answering `Jane@Acme.com, sam@acme.com` and verify `approvers` reads `["jane@acme.com", "sam@acme.com"]` and the output contains `git config gpg.format ssh` and `git config commit.gpgsign true`

rule_text: Only `approved` asks who may approve; the emails are lower-cased into `approvers` and the one-time commit-signing setup is printed for each of them

tests.name: test_only_approved_is_asked
test_the_emails_are_written_and_the_signing_setup_printed
